sources.evidence_limit: Reference capture, VECTOR translation offsets and finite P-device buffers are explicit Pythonic choices; no native compiler, serial timing, controller or physical motion equivalence is established

reference_for_counters.capture: Ordinary writable INTEGER field/ARRAY/USING storage captured once before initialization, retained despite later index changes and used for every iteration and cleanup
reference_for_counters.protection: Conservative aggregate-root writes/reuse, formal/nonlocal parameterized aliases, domain-constrained/resource roots and unproven global-aggregate external effects remain blocked
reference_for_counters.lifetime: Structured and dispatcher loops preserve bound order, nested scope checks, pause/resume and initialized-counter cleanup on every exit; initial capture/assignment failures preserve previous storage

vector_translation_frames.offsets: VECTOR left operands add translation to complete VECTOR/pose values; pose representation, orientation, CONFIG and external metadata remain detached and unchanged
vector_translation_frames.inverse: INV(VECTOR) returns an independent negative translation vector without synthesizing pose configuration
vector_translation_frames.construction: FRAME accepts complete VECTOR point locations but requires a pose/model-backed joint origin for CONFIG; retain existing geometry bounds and full pose validation

serial_streams.routing: Explicit SerialStreams reserves numeric P-device prefixes and accepts configured canonical P1:..P5: endpoints only; no fallback, operating-system discovery or port opening
serial_streams.transfer: Finite ASCII/binary FILE input, append-only separate TX, close-time RX prefix consumption, exclusive validated handles and ordinary atomic typed-read checks
serial_streams.persistence: Bounded remaining RX, retained TX and capacities after close; live handles reject saving; no native connection or suspended reader is restored
serial_streams.boundary: Manual P1..P4 hardware descriptions do not establish physical P5 availability; no implicit SerialPorts settings, producer waiting, seek, XML/PASSALL or native serial timing

historical_notes: Supersedes earlier blanket field-counter, VECTOR-frame and serial-data exclusions; retain original per-feature ledger versions and strict regressions.
